Name: COOL_TIME_PARAM_ST
Description: Cooldowns that stop the host's world from being visited again by the same kind of multiplayer visitor. Row ID = group × 100 + visit count: 1xx invasions, 2xx and 3xx the two map-guardian types, 4xx hunters; the count (1–10, capped at 10) rises with each visit and resets once the watch time runs out. Columns 0–3 are picked by the number of co-op phantoms in the world at the visit (3 or more uses column 3). Taunter's Tongue changing state clears the invasion and guardian counts and timers, not the hunter ones.

Fields.Name: Block Time - 0 Co-op Phantoms
Fields.Description: Seconds. After a visit of this row's group, the world can't be visited by that group again until this runs out. Used when no co-op phantoms are present. 0: no block. Retail: 900 (1xx–3xx), 120 (4xx).

Fields.Name: Watch Time - 0 Co-op Phantoms
Fields.Description: Seconds. Starts when the block time ends; another visit of the group before it runs out uses the next row (count + 1), otherwise the count resets to row x01. Used when no co-op phantoms are present. Retail 1xx–3xx: 600 at count 1–2, 480 at 3–5, 300 at 6–8, 180 at 9–10; 4xx: 900.

Fields.Name: Block Time - 1 Co-op Phantom
Fields.Description: Seconds. As Block Time - 0 Co-op Phantoms, used with 1 co-op phantom present. Retail: 600 (1xx–3xx), 120 (4xx).

Fields.Name: Watch Time - 1 Co-op Phantom
Fields.Description: Seconds. As Watch Time - 0 Co-op Phantoms, used with 1 co-op phantom present. Retail: 450 (1xx–3xx), 900 (4xx).

Fields.Description: Seconds. As Block Time - 0 Co-op Phantoms, used with 2 co-op phantoms present. Retail: 300 (1xx–3xx), 180 (4xx).

Fields.Name: Watch Time - 2 Co-op Phantoms
Fields.Description: Seconds. As Watch Time - 0 Co-op Phantoms, used with 2 co-op phantoms present. Retail: 200 (1xx–3xx), 900 (4xx).

Fields.Description: Seconds. As Watch Time - 0 Co-op Phantoms, used with 3 or more co-op phantoms present. Retail: 0 on 1xx–3xx, 900 on 4xx.
